name: smwmusic-super-mario-sunshine-revenge-of-the-chuckster-delfino-plaza-remix
title: Super Mario Sunshine - Revenge of the Chuckster ~ Delfino Plaza (Remix)
description:
I'm a chuckster!

Was feeling very nostalgic, me, so I decided to do an arrangement of Delfino Plaza from Super Mario Sunshine. God! I love this place. It has got some of the most personality in any town hub. Scratch that! It has the most. The Piantas are so cool. They live their lives dancing, yelling at each other, cursing Mario's name, and even chucking him because they're chucksters!!! If only this place was real... *starts shaking his TV* LET ME IN!!!!



Important:
♠ Thunder SFX is disabled.

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. Enables Voice Clip, but at the cost of SMW-Compatibility
2. Disables Voice Clip (turned on default)
